question: A file with the _______ file extension is a Word Open XML Macro-Enabled Document file.
solution:
The correct answer is __**.docm**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **A Word Open XML Macro-Enabled Document file with the DOCM extension is used in Microsoft Word.**
 
• It first appeared in Office 2007. DOCM files are similar to DOCX files, but they can also run macros, allowing you to automate repetitive activities in Word.
 
• DOCM files, like DOCX files, can store formatted text, pictures, shapes, charts, and other data.
 
• This format, like Microsoft's other XML formats like DOCX and XLSX, employs XML and ZIP to compress data into a smaller size.
 
• The primary software tool for opening and editing DOCM files is Microsoft Word (version 2007 and higher).
